what: a bearded iron axe: a narrow-necked warm-silver axe head whose lower edge drops into a long hooked beard below the neck, a near-white top bevel and a soft warm-grey outline, a gold collar band, the handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, head at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner; the same handle, collar and pommel as an ordinary iron axe, only the head differs
